newsitem.title: FINLAND: Bulls overseas power Helsinki stocks near highs.
newsitem.headline: Bulls overseas power Helsinki stocks near highs.

text.p: Shares rose clearly in solid volumes on Tuesday, shaking off Monday's hesitance on Finland's ERM entry as overseas bulls made the pace; but the index did not quite breach year-high levels as in other European markets.
The HEX index ended up 1.55 percent at 2,223.99 with volume a solid 472 million markka, about one-third in Nokia which picked up five markka to 210.50.

As Helsinki blew with winds from overseas, brokers were unsure if an attempt could come on Wednesday on the HEX's 2,226.6 year-high dating to October 8; some voiced the view that more moderate gains would prove easier to sustain.
Besides bellwhether Nokia, Merita stayed well in focus and rallied further; and insurers as well as Finnlines continued strong. Forestries picked up after a queazy session on Monday.
"Players are now very pessimistic on forestries, so even moderate results could turn them higher," said one broker, looking ahead to reports from UPM and Metsa-Serla on Thursday.
"Merita looks technically strong," said another, targeting resistance for the bank's A share at about 15 markka.
Finnlines -- in the spotlight since it boosted its holding in Sweden's BTL last week -- grabbed seven percent of total volume and touched a year-high before ending up five at 105.50.

Huhtamaki and Amer -- in a way two unsynchronised recovery stories -- were both firm in good volumes; the recently upbeat confectioner and packager rising three markka to 176.00, the reorganising sports goods maker lifting two markka to 110.00.

Raisio put on 3.50 markka to 263.00 as it promised more news next week about international distribution for its Benecol cholesterol-cutting margarine, keeping investor appetites whetted after it reported a fall in January-August profits.
